recipe.notes: in_prior: otp.generators.primitives.in_prior(seed) components stepped separately; controlled: single or paired components with gridded parameters; regime: mean/variance/frequency jump with the switch d = d_frac * T steps before the origin (context placement) and Markov-switching AR; chaos: configs of otp.grids.chaos.param_list; tails: stable AR, fBm, Hawkes, MSM grids of otp.grids.tails; mixture: random genomes of otp.generators.mixture.
